name: Daemon's Blood Plate

Tie or higher: the threat level is learned and the plate is kept. Lower: the plate breaks and the user takes the difference as damage to both HP and MP. description: A Bard needs an instrument to play Spellsongs and Finales. Instruments count as Stance 2H unless stated otherwise; one that cannot play a melody gives -4 to Performance checks and requires singing (CR II p.102).

name: Akane's Flute
summary: Flourish Value counts as 1 lower for Extra Rhythm.
description: When playing Spellsongs with this flute, the check for generating Extra Rhythm treats the Flourish Value as 1 lower.

name: Pet (Small Bird)
summary: Small Bird pet that helps continue a Bard's spellsongs; requires Bard 3.
description: Small Bird pet. Bards of level 3+ can have a pet (another at levels 5 and 7, max 3). Pets have no HP/MP; they continue one of the Bard's Spellsongs with success value 0 (preventing Rhythm attrition, generating no Rhythm), up to 3 times per day for at most 3 minutes (18 rounds), within 2-3 areas (10m radius); they cannot perform Finales. Each pet type can only perform certain Spellsongs. More expensive pets give no extra benefit (CR II p.107-109).

name: Pet (Frog)

description: Frog pet. Bards of level 3+ can have a pet (another at levels 5 and 7, max 3). description: Lute of Passion (red), one of three Fabled Lutes. When played, a Spellsong's effect condition or a Finale's Rhythm cost is reduced by one Uplifting (up) Rhythm. Special Instrument: needs the combat feat [Special Instrument Proficiency] to use.

summary: Spellsong conditions and Finale costs need one less Calming (down) Rhythm.

name: Horn of the Muse
summary: On a Performance check reaching the Flourish Value, generates one extra Rhythm.
description: When a Spellsong is played with it and the Performance check's success value meets or beats the Flourish Value, one additional Rhythm is generated besides the normal Extra Rhythm; choose one type from the song's Base or Extra Rhythm. Special Instrument: needs the combat feat [Special Instrument Proficiency] to use.

name: Mystic Ink
summary: Writing fades to invisibility; readable with Keen-Flash Glasses.
description: Text written with it soon becomes invisible; it can still be read by someone wearing Keen-Flash Glasses.

name: Smoke Grapher
summary: Pipe whose exhaled smoke forms short, silent moving images.
description: The smoker shapes exhaled smoke into an imagined image: colorless, soundless, about one minute of looping motion, room-sized at most. It is plainly smoke and cannot fool anyone. It lasts while the air is still; any breeze stronger than a gentle one (or the user) disperses it.

name: Daemon's Crystallized Blood Plate
summary: Reveals the threat level of a Shallow Abyss (up to 13).
description: Works like the Daemon's Blood Plate (CR I p.304) but functions up to threat level 13; against 14+ it crumbles and becomes useless.

name: Immovable Rod
summary: Fixes itself in place on a password; supports nearly 1 ton.
description: Held in hand and activated by its password, the rod locks in place in midair and becomes extremely strong, bearing almost one ton (usable as a ladder with rope or several rods). Another password releases it.

name: Potion Ball
summary: Lets a potion be thrown with a thrown-weapon attack; needs [Throwing].
description: Soft ball filled with a potion (Major Action). Requires the combat feat [Throwing]. Thrown as a thrown weapon attack; on hitting it bursts and applies the potion to the target, the potion's effect counting as Resistance: Optional. It does not break just from being carried.

name: Jack Beans
summary: Grows a sturdy climbable vine up to 20m long (1 MP).
description: Use with a Major Action and 1 MP: grows a vine up to 10cm thick and 20m long in the direction the user wills, 1m per round (10 seconds). It holds up to 300 kg and can be climbed. It withers after 24 hours but can still be used as a plain rope.

name: Unicorn Horn
summary: Touch: heals 50 HP and cures poison, disease, etc.; harms undead. Priced per use.
description: Price: 6,000G per remaining use (1-8 uses when bought; they cannot be restored). A touch restores 50 HP and removes poison, disease, curse, petrification and similar effects with a success value of 17 or less; it does not work on Undead, Constructs or Magitech. Touched Undead must make a Fortitude check vs 17 or take 50 magic damage. It shatters when its uses run out.

name: Headband of Concentration
summary: Retrying Knowledge package checks takes half the time; requires Sage 3.
description: Rerolls of Knowledge Check Package checks take half the time normally needed (the first check takes normal time). Requires Sage level 3. Renowned item: purchase also costs reputation.

name: Reckless Headband
summary: Allows the feat [Reckless Counter] once; destroyed after use.
description: The wearer can use [Reckless Counter] (any Warrior-type class): when targeted by a melee attack, the wearer's counterattack hits automatically, but the enemy's attack also hits automatically and its damage roll counts as 12 (criticals resolved normally). Once per round, and not in the same round as [Counter]. The headband is destroyed after a [Reckless Counter].

name: Crown of the Saint
summary: HP-healing spells still heal Magic Power (+ modifiers) on double 1s.
description: When the wearer casts HP recovery magic using the power table, a roll of double 1s still heals the Magic Power (plus additional modifiers); in that case no 50 XP is awarded for the automatic failure.

name: Taste Piercing
summary: +2 to Herbology checks made by tasting.
description: Tongue piercing that sharpens taste: +2 on Herbology checks performed by tasting (licking, sipping).

name: Mask of the Fearless
summary: Recovers 10 extra HP when rising from 0 or less HP to 1+.
description: Each time the wearer's HP rises from 0 or below to a positive value (including through [Awaken]), they immediately regain 10 more HP.

name: Earplugs
summary: Blocks out sounds.
description: Ear accessory that shuts out sound.

name: Golden Earplugs
summary: +2 Willpower against Spellsongs and Finales.
description: The wearer gets +2 on Willpower checks against Spellsongs and Finales; other sounds are heard normally.

name: Tongues Earpiece
summary: Understand up to five chosen spoken languages.
description: The wearer can understand (hear) up to five spoken languages set in the earring; reading and writing are not granted. Unset slots are chosen by the wearer and cannot be changed later. 5,000G with all five languages preset; +5,000G for each language left unset.

name: Linkpearls
summary: Pair of earrings: wearers can talk at any distance once a day for 10 minutes.
description: Sold as a pair. The two wearers can converse freely once per day for up to 10 minutes regardless of distance. Wearing a second set in another section to link both pairs is not possible.

name: Amulet of Light
summary: +1 Evasion, Fortitude and Willpower against Undead.
description: When attacked by Undead, the wearer gets +1 on Evasion, Fortitude and Willpower checks.

name: Bear Claws
summary: [Bear Muscle] gives +1 more (Strength bonus +3 instead of +2).
description: While worn, the Enhancer technique [Bear Muscle] is 1 stronger, raising the Strength bonus to +3. Price as in the list (p.226); the detailed data (p.237) prints 3,000.

name: Weapon Holder
summary: Carries 1 weapon, shield or item on the back; swap it with a Minor Action.
description: Holds one item. Weapons, shields, hand-held items or instruments can be hung on or taken off its hooks in Combat Preparation, or with a Minor Action before taking a Major Action (an equipment change), working like a scabbard/holster. Holders worn together add their capacity; storing needs an empty hook.

name: Rangers' Cloak
summary: Cloak modification letting another accessory share the back slot; requires Ranger 3.
description: Cloak upgrade costing 1,000G + 20 reputation in addition to the cloak itself: one extra non-cloak accessory can be equipped in the back section. Requires Ranger level 3; otherwise neither the cloak nor the added accessory works. The cloak gets a new name (e.g. Rangers' Thermal Mantle).

name: Modified Weapon Holder
summary: Carries up to 2 weapons, shields or items on the back.
description: Holds up to two items. Weapons, shields, hand-held items or instruments can be hung on or taken off its hooks in Combat Preparation, or with a Minor Action before taking a Major Action (an equipment change), working like a scabbard/holster. Holders worn together add their capacity; storing needs an empty hook.

name: Hero's Mantle
summary: Damage from [... Breath] attacks -2.
description: Damage the wearer takes from attacks whose name ends in "Breath" (e.g. [Fire Breath]) is reduced by 2.

name: Rainbow Ring
summary: Command word (Minor Action): colored light over 2-3 areas; white light acts as [Light].
description: With a Minor Action and a command word the ring lights 2-3 areas (10m radius) in a chosen color; white light counts as the [Light] spell. It only glows while worn and can only be turned off by removing it.

name: Mana Ring
summary: Magic damage +1; counts as a Magical Implement.
description: The wearer's spells that directly deal damage deal +1 damage (not e.g. [Enchant Weapon] or [Solid Bullet]). It can also serve as a Magical Implement.

name: Utility Belt
summary: Belt modification letting another accessory share the waist slot; requires Scout 3.
description: Belt upgrade costing 1,000G + 20 reputation in addition to the belt itself: one extra non-belt accessory can be equipped in the waist section. Requires Scout level 3; otherwise neither the belt nor the added accessory works. The belt gets a new name (e.g. Utility Gun Belt).

name: Coward Belt
summary: Password (Major Action): launch yourself 20m, taking 20 falling damage.
description: With a Major Action and password the wearer is propelled 20m and takes 20 points of falling damage; this also withdraws them from a skirmish. Simplified Combat: always backwards into their own rear area. Standard Combat: any direction, fixed distance.

name: Missile Trapper
summary: Umbrella that may block a ranged weapon attack like [Missile Protection].
description: When targeted by a ranged weapon attack, open it before the Evasion check and roll 1d (handled like [Missile Protection]): 1-3 no effect (close it with a Major Action to reuse); 4-6 the attack is avoided automatically and the umbrella is destroyed.

name: Unbending Buckle
summary: May resist gun attacks with Willpower instead of Evasion.
description: Against Gun attacks or Magic Arrow/Quarrel shots, the wearer may roll Willpower instead of Evasion. Success halves the damage (no damage with the racial ability [Mana Interference]); failure means full damage.

name: True Black Belt
summary: Defense +2; requires Grappler 3; does not stack with Black Belt.
description: The wearer gains +2 Defense. Requires Grappler level 3. Does not stack with the Black Belt. Renowned item: purchase also costs reputation.

name: Skanda Boots
summary: Movement +5.
description: Movement +5 (Full Move +15m, Normal Move +5m). No change to area movement in Simplified Combat.

name: Lucky Feathers
summary: Area: Line effects only catch the wearer on 1-2 instead of 1-3.
description: When determining whether the wearer is caught in an "Area: Line" effect, they are affected only on a 1-2 (instead of 1-3).

name: Cat's Eye Rivet
summary: Grants Double Attack: two attacks on a single target with one action.
description: Grants the major-action skill Double Attack: one action lets the golem strike a single target two times. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Golden Cat's Eye Rivet
summary: Upgrade of Cat's Eye Rivet: Twin Strike & Double Attack (two attacks, separate checks, any targets).
description: Only usable together with Cat's Eye Rivet and replaces its Double Attack with the major-action skill Twin Strike & Double Attack: two attacks per round, each with its own Accuracy check, which may hit different characters. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Tiger's Eye Rivet
summary: Grants Continuous Attack I: a melee hit allows a second attack.
description: Grants the passive skill Continuous Attack I: after hitting a target in melee, the golem may attack that target once more. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Golden Tiger's Eye Rivet
summary: Upgrade of Tiger's Eye Rivet: Continuous Attack II (up to three chained attacks).
description: Only usable together with Tiger's Eye Rivet and replaces its Continuous Attack with the passive skill Continuous Attack II: a melee hit allows a second attack, and if that hits, a third against the same target. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Jet Sign
summary: Grants Aimed Attack: may take Accuracy +2 with damage -4.
description: Grants the passive skill Aimed Attack: when attacking, the golem may gain +2 Accuracy at the cost of -4 damage. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Sunstone Brilliance
summary: Grants Sunstone Brilliance ("Brand"): next round's attack cannot miss and deals extra damage.
description: Grants the major-action skill Sunstone Brilliance (called Brand in CR III): the golem takes a wide stance; its attack next round hits automatically, cannot be evaded, and deals increased damage (amount set by each golem). Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Spinel Horn
summary: Grants Charge: after a Normal Move, +1 damage per 5m moved.
description: Grants the major-action skill Charge, usable only after a Normal Move: a melee charge that, on a hit, deals +1 damage (+2 in Simplified Combat) per 5m travelled in a straight line. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Malachite Feather
summary: Grants All-Out Attack: +8 damage on the next attack, Evasion -3 this turn.
description: Grants the declared skill All-Out Attack: the golem's next attack deals +8 damage, but its Evasion checks this turn take -3. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Lapis Lazuli Weight
summary: Grants Tail Swing I: tail attack on up to 3 targets (one check at -1).
description: Grants the declared skill Tail Swing I: the golem attacks up to 3 targets in the same skirmish with its tail, using a single Accuracy check at -1. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Quartz Counterweight
summary: Upgrade of Lapis Lazuli Weight: Tail Swing II hits up to 5 targets.
description: Only usable together with Lapis Lazuli Weight and replaces Tail Swing I with the declared skill Tail Swing II: a tail attack against up to 5 targets in the same skirmish. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Bright Red Ruby
summary: Grants Flame Breath (fire attack; data depends on the golem).
description: Grants the major-action skill Flame Breath, a fire-type attack whose data is given in each golem's entry. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Amethyst of Purple Lightning
summary: Grants Discharge or Lightning (lightning attack; data depends on the golem).
description: Grants the major-action skill Discharge or Lightning, a lightning-type attack whose data is given in each golem's entry. The Small price follows CR III p.434 and the golem data (CR II p.415 prints -/1,600). Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Blue Lotus Jade
summary: Grants Water Gun or Blizzard Breath (water/ice attack; data depends on the golem).
description: Grants the major-action skill Water Gun or Blizzard Breath, a water/ice-type attack whose data is given in each golem's entry. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Calcite Compound Eyes
summary: Grants Breath Control: exclude chosen characters from its breath/lightning.
description: Grants the passive skill Breath Control: the golem may leave any characters out of the targets of its Flame Breath, Blizzard Breath or Lightning. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Obsidian Shield
summary: Grants Cover: as [Cover I] (Small) or [Cover II] (Medium/Large).
description: Grants the declared, combat-preparation skill Cover, working like the combat feat [Cover I] at Small grade and [Cover II] at Medium and Large grade. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Corundum Protection
summary: Grants Guardian: as [Guardian I] (Small/Medium) or [Guardian II] (Large).
description: Grants the passive skill Guardian, working like the combat feat [Guardian I] (Small/Medium grade) or [Guardian II] (Large grade). Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Amber Eye
summary: Grants Ultimate Aim: Accuracy +4.
description: Grants the passive skill Ultimate Aim: the golem gets +4 on Accuracy checks. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Coral Branch
summary: Grants Block (as the combat feat); must be used on all sections.
description: Grants the passive skill Block, identical to the combat feat [Block]. A multi-section golem must have it on all sections. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Garnet of Vitality
summary: Grants HP Enhancement: max HP +5/+10/+15 by grade.
description: Grants the passive skill HP Enhancement: maximum HP +5 (Small), +10 (Medium) or +15 (Large). Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Focused Garnet of Vitality
summary: Grants Improved HP Enhancement: another max HP +5/+10/+15, stacking.
description: Grants the passive skill Improved HP Enhancement: maximum HP +5 (Small), +10 (Medium) or +15 (Large); it stacks with HP Enhancement. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Shimmering Onyx
summary: Grants Mana Coating: magic damage to the section -3.
description: Grants the passive skill Mana Coating: magic damage the section receives is reduced by 3. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Red Iron Blood
summary: Grants Mobility Enhancement: movement +5 (all modes); all sections.
description: Grants the passive skill Mobility Enhancement: every movement mode gets +5. A multi-section golem must have it on all sections. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Yellow Flint
summary: Grants Fast Reaction: the golem can use [Footwork]; all sections.
description: Grants the passive skill Fast Reaction: the golem can use the combat feat [Footwork]. A multi-section golem must have it on all sections. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Anisotropic Anorthite
summary: Underwater golem can move on land; gains Underwater Specialization.
description: For golems with Underwater: they can also move on land, and Underwater is replaced by the passive skill Underwater Specialization (no penalties for moving underwater; -2 to all action checks on land). A multi-section golem must have it on all sections. No Large price is listed (no golem uses the Large grade). Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Moonstone of Serenity
summary: Golem's Weak Point becomes None and [... Vulnerability] is removed.
description: The golem's Weak Point becomes "None" and any [... Vulnerability] unique skill is removed. A multi-section golem must have it on all sections. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Quartz Disruptor
summary: Grants Type Resistance: damage of one chosen type is halved.
description: At creation choose earth, water/ice, wind, fire, lightning or energy (not the golem's weak point type). Grants the passive skill Type Resistance: damage of that type is automatically halved, and negated if a "Resistance: Half" check succeeds; non-damage effects of that type still apply fully. A multi-section golem must have it on all sections. Golem Enhancing Item applied when casting [Create Golem]; its grade (Small/Medium/Large) must match the golem, and it can be recovered and reused. Duplicate items do not stack. Large grade prices: CR III p.434.

name: Fairy Tamer's Gem (Level 11-12)
summary: Gem needed to cast Fairy Magic, grade for Fairy Tamer level 11-12 (1,800G for all 6).
description: Grade for Fairy Tamer level 11-12: 300G each, 1,800G for a full set of 6. Required to cast Fairy Magic; one gem per magic type, each equipped as Accessory: Any in its own section (4 sections in total) unless a Gem Case or Ornate Jewelry is used. Higher grades are needed from Fairy Tamer level 11 on (CR III p.114).

name: Fairy Tamer's Gem (Level 13-14)
summary: Gem needed to cast Fairy Magic, grade for Fairy Tamer level 13-14 (2,100G for all 6).
description: Grade for Fairy Tamer level 13-14: 350G each, 2,100G for a full set of 6. Required to cast Fairy Magic; one gem per magic type, each equipped as Accessory: Any in its own section (4 sections in total) unless a Gem Case or Ornate Jewelry is used. Higher grades are needed from Fairy Tamer level 11 on (CR III p.114).

name: Fairy Tamer's Gem (Level 15)
summary: Gem needed to cast Fairy Magic, grade for Fairy Tamer level 15 (2,400G for all 6).
description: Grade for Fairy Tamer level 15: 400G each, 2,400G for a full set of 6. Required to cast Fairy Magic; one gem per magic type, each equipped as Accessory: Any in its own section (4 sections in total) unless a Gem Case or Ornate Jewelry is used. Higher grades are needed from Fairy Tamer level 11 on (CR III p.114).

name: Stylish Riding Clothes
summary: Riding checks +1.
description: Fashionable riding outfit granting +1 on riding checks. Renowned item: purchase also costs reputation.

name: Carriage Fare
summary: Carriage ride for a distance of about 1 hour; +5G per extra hour.
description: Fare for a carriage trip reachable in about 1 hour; longer trips cost 5G more per additional hour.

name: Magical Train Fare (Second Class)
summary: Second-class magical train ticket for a trip of about 12 hours.
description: Second-class compartment for a journey of roughly 12 hours; the fare rises in proportion to distance.

name: Magical Train Fare (First Class)
summary: First-class magical train ticket.
description: First-class compartment on a magical train; the fare rises in proportion to distance.

name: Airfreight Fare
summary: Air travel fare, per itinerary per day (fare only).
description: Passage by air; the price is per itinerary and day and covers only the fare.

name: Charter Wagon (1 Passenger)
summary: Chartered wagon with coachman for 1 passenger and baggage, per day.
description: Daily charter including the coachman: 500G for one passenger with baggage, 750G for 2, 1,000G for 4. On extended days the passengers' meals etc. are paid separately.

name: Charter Wagon (2 Passengers)
summary: Chartered wagon with coachman for 2 passengers and baggage, per day.
description: Daily charter including the coachman: 500G for one passenger with baggage, 750G for 2, 1,000G for 4. On extended days the passengers' meals etc. are paid separately.

name: Charter Wagon (4 Passengers)
summary: Chartered wagon with coachman for 4 passengers and baggage, per day.
description: Daily charter including the coachman: 500G for one passenger with baggage, 750G for 2, 1,000G for 4. On extended days the passengers' meals etc. are paid separately.

name: Small Airship Charter
summary: Small airship with its crew, per day.
description: The airship is only rented with its crew; the daily price includes the crew's meals and other expenses.

name: Antidote Potion III
summary: Removes poison-type effects with a success value of 25 or less.
description: Cancels every poison-type effect on the drinker whose success value is 25 or lower. Drunk with a Major Action. Potion effects are poison-type.

name: Cure Stone Potion III
summary: Removes petrification effects with a success value of 25 or less; can be sprinkled.
description: Applied to a petrified character, it removes petrification effects whose success value is 25 or lower. Can be sprinkled on a character within touch range (or oneself) with a Major Action, also in combat. Potion effects are poison-type.

name: Scarlet Potion
summary: Max HP +10 for 6 rounds and heals 10 HP (+ Ranger bonus).
description: For 1 minute (6 rounds) maximum HP rises by 10, and current HP is restored by 10 (a Ranger adds Ranger level + Intelligence modifier to this healing). A second dose during the duration only heals. Drunk with a Major Action. Potion effects are poison-type.

name: Repair Tape I
summary: Restores HP of a construct or magitech with Power 10.
description: With a Major Action it instantly restores HP to a construct or magitech character (or section): Power 10 on the power table + the user's Rider level + Dexterity modifier; it cannot crit. Tape comes as I (Power 10), II (Power 40) and III (Power 70).

name: Repair Tape II
summary: Restores HP of a construct or magitech with Power 40.
description: With a Major Action it instantly restores HP to a construct or magitech character (or section): Power 40 on the power table + the user's Rider level + Dexterity modifier; it cannot crit. Tape comes as I (Power 10), II (Power 40) and III (Power 70).

name: Repair Tape III
summary: Restores HP of a construct or magitech with Power 70.
description: With a Major Action it instantly restores HP to a construct or magitech character (or section): Power 70 on the power table + the user's Rider level + Dexterity modifier; it cannot crit. Tape comes as I (Power 10), II (Power 40) and III (Power 70).

name: Mechanized Fingers
summary: 2 MP: Disable Device +2 for 10 minutes; also works as Scout's Tools.
description: Glove worn on one hand. Spending 2 MP runs it for 10 minutes, granting +2 on Disable Device checks. It can replace Scout's Tools. Putting it on or taking it off takes 1 minute (6 rounds).

name: Apothecary's Tools
summary: Herb healing rolls 1d+4 on the power table instead of 2d.
description: When healing HP or MP with herbs that use the power table, the user may roll 1d+4 instead of 2d.

name: Magic Pipe
summary: +1 to herb recovery on yourself.
description: Inhaling herb smoke through the pipe adds +1 to HP/MP recovered from herbs, only when the user treats themself.

name: Alchemy Kit
summary: Required to use Evocations; holds the Material Cards.
description: An Alchemist must have it equipped (right hand, left hand, waist or Other section) to use Evocations; the Material Cards used must be in the kit, which can hold over 100 cards (CR III p.108-112).

name: Card Shooter
summary: Pistol-style Alchemy Kit: Evocation range X(Ym) becomes 2(Y+10m).
description: A 1H handgun-type Alchemy Kit. Evocations with Range X(Ym) used through it count as Range 2(Y+10m); with the feat [Distant Evocations], Touch-range Evocations become 2(20m). No holster included.

name: Material Card (B-Rank)
summary: B-rank card consumed to fuel Evocations.
description: Consumed by Alchemist Evocations; the card's rank (B) sets the effect. Five colors (red, green, black, white, gold) cost the same; card prices are 20/200/2,000/20,000G for B/A/S/SS (CR III p.112).

name: Material Card (A-Rank)
summary: A-rank card consumed to fuel Evocations.
description: Consumed by Alchemist Evocations; the card's rank (A) sets the effect. Five colors (red, green, black, white, gold) cost the same; card prices are 20/200/2,000/20,000G for B/A/S/SS (CR III p.112).

name: Material Card (S-Rank)
summary: S-rank card consumed to fuel Evocations.
description: Consumed by Alchemist Evocations; the card's rank (S) sets the effect. Five colors (red, green, black, white, gold) cost the same; card prices are 20/200/2,000/20,000G for B/A/S/SS (CR III p.112).

name: Material Card (SS-Rank)
summary: SS-rank card consumed to fuel Evocations.
description: Consumed by Alchemist Evocations; the card's rank (SS) sets the effect. Five colors (red, green, black, white, gold) cost the same; card prices are 20/200/2,000/20,000G for B/A/S/SS (CR III p.112).

name: Tiny Armor (+3)
summary: Armor for a familiar: Defense +3.
description: Armor that any familiar created with [Familiar] or [Familiar II] can wear, giving it +3 Defense (2,120G for +3, 6,120G for +6).

name: Tiny Armor (+6)
summary: Armor for a familiar: Defense +6.
description: Armor that any familiar created with [Familiar] or [Familiar II] can wear, giving it +6 Defense (2,120G for +3, 6,120G for +6).

name: Chalk of the Lost
summary: Marks glow when their maker passes them again.
description: A mark drawn with it lights up strongly whenever the person who drew it passes by again (every time, with no indication of how often). One chalk lasts over 100 uses; marks remain about a month.

name: Puzzling Sign
summary: 3 MP: target takes -2 to Intelligence-based checks for 4-1d rounds.
description: Major Action, 3 MP, Range/Area 1(10m)/Shot, Resistance Can't: 1 character (section) is distracted by an illusory riddle and takes -2 on all checks using Intelligence (including spellcasting) for 4-1d rounds (minimum 1). Only affects targets with Intelligence 12+ or intelligence High/Average. Curse + psychic type; counts as success value 0 when compared.

name: Mana Cartridge (X)
summary: Stores 10 MP for powering magitech.
description: Type X: holds 10 MP. Attaches to a magitech mount, or to an item of the Magitech Civilization or Current era that spends MP (one cartridge per item); its MP can only power that magitech. Attaching or removing takes 1 minute (6 rounds); an Artificer (level 1+) can do it with a Major Action and refill it from their own MP, a mako stone or another cartridge.

name: Mana Cartridge (XI)

description: Type XI: holds 11 MP. Attaching or removing takes 1 minute (6 rounds); an Artificer (level 1+) can do it with a Major Action and refill it from their own MP, a mako stone or another cartridge. Renowned item: purchase also costs reputation.

name: Great Daemon's Crystallized Blood Plate
summary: Reveals the threat level of a Shallow Abyss (up to 25).
description: Works like the Daemon's Blood Plate (CR I p.304) but functions up to threat level 25.

name: Fairy Lantern
summary: 3 MP: 12 hours of light invisible to those with soulscars.
description: Activated with a Major Action, its password and 3 MP: a magical flame burns for 12 hours without tinderbox or oil and lights 2-3 areas (10m radius). Creatures with soulscars cannot see this light and remain in darkness unless they have Darkvision.

name: Cattleya Garland
summary: Fairy Magic with Range X(Ym) counts as Range 2(Y+10m).
description: The wearer's Fairy Magic spells with a range of X(Ym) count as having range 2(Y+10m).

name: Goddess's Veil
summary: Healing magic can crit (Critical Value 10); women only.
description: A female wearer's healing magic is treated as having Critical Value 10, so healing spells can crit. No effect for male wearers.

name: Crown of Riches
summary: Roll healing for multiple targets first, then assign the results; men only.
description: When a Divine Magic HP-healing spell (e.g. [Cure Wounds]) affects several targets at once, the wearer rolls all the recovery amounts first and then assigns them to targets as desired (also for damaging undead, after resistance results are known). Only works for male wearers.

name: Night Goggles
summary: Minor Action + 1 MP: Darkvision for 1 round.
description: With a Minor Action and 1 MP (from the goggles' own 10 MP or the wearer's) the wearer gains [Darkvision] for 10 seconds (1 round). The stored MP only powers this effect; an Artificer can refill it from own MP or a mako stone with a Major Action using a small magisphere.

name: Hunter's Eyes
summary: Failed Monster Knowledge still reveals level; success gives +1 Accuracy.
description: Even on a failed Monster Knowledge check the wearer learns the target's level (monster or adventurer level). On a success, they get +1 on Accuracy checks against that monster.

modifiers.condition: vs a monster identified with Monster Knowledge

name: Linkpearls Holder
summary: Lets several Linkpearls be worn at once.
description: Earring mount holding several Linkpearls (CR II p.236) so they all work; it does not extend their abilities and only one pair can talk at a time. Listening works with it in place, but it must be removed to speak or all fitted pearls activate. Price by capacity: 2 pearls 3,000G, 3 pearls 6,000G, 4 pearls 10,000G, 5 pearls 15,000G, and so on.

name: Stone Man's Earring (Dexterity)
summary: Dexterity -6, Defense +1.
description: Partly petrifies the wearer: Dexterity -6 (each earring is fixed to either Dexterity or Agility) in exchange for +1 Defense.

name: Stone Man's Earring (Agility)
summary: Agility -6, Defense +1.
description: Partly petrifies the wearer: Agility -6 (each earring is fixed to either Dexterity or Agility) in exchange for +1 Defense.

name: Miracle Necklace
summary: Shatter it to reroll a failed Death Check.
description: If the unconscious wearer fails a Death Check, they may shatter the necklace to reroll it and must keep the second result.

name: Curse Rebellion
summary: Damage to Daemons +3; damage taken from Daemons -3.
description: The wearer's melee and ranged attacks and spells deal +3 damage to Daemons, and physical and magic damage from Daemon attacks on the wearer is reduced by 3.

name: Inverness, a Beautiful Star
summary: Minor Action: create a B-rank Throwing Star that lasts 1 round.
description: With a Minor Action (before any Major Action; counts as equipping a weapon) the wearer creates a B-rank Throwing Star thrown weapon (CR III p.231). Unlimited uses; each star vanishes after 10 seconds (1 round).

name: Smart Animal Sack
summary: +1 to Search, Monster Knowledge, Notice, Danger Sense and Spot Trap.
description: A talking backpack that advises in Arcana. If the wearer speaks Arcana, they get +1 on Search, Monster Knowledge, Notice, Danger Sense and Spot Trap checks.

name: Level Ring
summary: Highest ability score -1, lowest +2; can be broken to swap values for one check.
description: While worn, the highest ability score drops by 1 and the lowest rises by 2 (wearer picks on ties). Right after a check using the raised score (even after rolling), the ring can be destroyed to use the lowered score's value instead. Only one can be worn; Ability-Enhancing Rings/Bracelets lose their permanent effect while it is worn (their break effect still works but cannot be combined with this one).

name: Big Gloves
summary: Equip weapons/shields with Min STR up to 5 above your Strength; worn on both hands.
description: Must be worn on both the right and left hand sections (not Other); the price is for the pair. The wearer can equip weapons and shields whose Minimum Strength is up to 5 higher than their Strength (Fencer: half Strength rounded up + 5).

name: Ring of Righteous Belief
summary: Willpower +2; does not stack with Ring of the Mind.
description: The wearer gets +2 on Willpower checks. Not cumulative with the Ring of the Mind. Price as in the list (p.224); the detailed data (p.243) prints 8,000.

name: Sunflower Buckle
summary: +1 Fortitude and Willpower against undead spells and skills.
description: The wearer gets +1 on Fortitude and Willpower checks against spells and unique skills used by Undead.

name: Green Belt
summary: Counts as always being in a natural environment.
description: Classes and abilities of the wearer work anywhere as if the wearer (or target) were in a natural environment (CR I p.101).

name: Light Boots
summary: Stand up immediately after falling prone; no prone penalties.
description: The wearer can get up right after being knocked prone and suffers none of the penalties for falling prone and standing up. The fall itself and damage from Throw-like attacks are not prevented.

name: Thieves Boots
summary: 10 MP: teleport up to 2m through obstacles, reappearing next turn.
description: Major Action, password and 10 MP: move up to 2m regardless of obstacles (the point need not be visible; state direction and distance in Arcana). The wearer vanishes and reappears at the start of their next turn, immune to all effects meanwhile; if the spot is occupied they return to the starting point. Each further use on the same day costs 10 MP more (20, 30...).

name: Sign of Valor: Skill
summary: If the ability growth roll shows no 1 or 2, roll an extra die.
description: Must be worn for the whole session. If the dice for post-session ability score growth contain no 1 or 2, the wearer rolls one additional die and may use it to determine the growth. Signs with different effects cannot be worn together.

name: Sign of Valor: Body
summary: If the ability growth roll shows no 3 or 4, roll an extra die.
description: Must be worn for the whole session. If the dice for post-session ability score growth contain no 3 or 4, the wearer rolls one additional die and may use it to determine the growth. Signs with different effects cannot be worn together.

name: Sign of Valor: Mind
summary: If the ability growth roll shows no 5 or 6, roll an extra die.
description: Must be worn for the whole session. If the dice for post-session ability score growth contain no 5 or 6, the wearer rolls one additional die and may use it to determine the growth. Signs with different effects cannot be worn together.
